title.zh: 【Zilliqa 将从独立 Layer 1 过渡到以太坊 Layer 2】
title.en: 【Zilliqa 将从独立 Layer 1 过渡到以太坊 Layer 2】

current_state.zh: Zilliqa announced it will transition from an independent Layer 1 blockchain to an Ethereum Layer 2 institutional network with built-in identity verification and compliance mechanisms, citing insufficient usage to sustain standalone operations.
current_state.en: Zilliqa announced it will transition from an independent Layer 1 blockchain to an Ethereum Layer 2 institutional network with built-in identity verification and compliance mechanisms, citing insufficient usage to sustain standalone operations.
